newsitem.title: USA: CBOT overnight Project A ag volume 550 contracts.
newsitem.headline: CBOT overnight Project A ag volume 550 contracts.

text.p: Chicago Board of Trade said Project A overnight agricultural contracts trading volume totalled 550 contracts, compared with 1144 contracts traded overnight Thursday.
There were 65 wheat, 287 corn, 153 soybean, 27 soymeal, six soyoil, eight oat, one wheat put, two corn puts and one soybean put.

In overnight trading, wheat was 1/4 cent higher to 3/4 cent lower, corn was unchanged to three cents higher, soybeans were unchanged to five cents higher, soymeal was $2.10 per ton up and soyoil was unchanged to 0.13 cent per lb higher.
